<thought>Search the template catalog with the correct functional group names: “ketones” and “C‑C double bonds” are broken in the forward carbonyl‑ene reaction, while “aliphatic hydroxyls” and “five‑membered rings” are formed. This should return a suitable retrosynthetic template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "[CH2:1]=[C:2]([c:3]1[cH:4][cH:5][cH:6][cH:7][cH:8]1)[C@@H:9]1[CH2:10][CH2:11][CH2:12][C@@:13]1([OH:14])[C:15]([F:16])([F:17])[F:18]",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls", "five-membered rings"],
  "bonds_formed": ["C-O", "C-C"],
  "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
  "limit": 5
}
